central_flow: 1. AI-ASSISTED WORK UPLOAD & TYPE (Written vs Visual)
2. CREATION HISTORY RECONSTRUCTION (Chronological event timeline with Actor Tags)
3. CREATION EVENTS DECOMPOSITION (Modality, Prompts, Direct Manual Edits, Iteration Steps)
4. HUMAN/AI CONTRIBUTION MAPPING (Qualitative Contribution Bars per component - NO % percentages)
5. JURISDICTION SELECTION (India - Indian Copyright Act 1957, US - USCO Compendium & Thaler/Kashtanova doctrine, UK - CDPA 1988 s.9(3) Computer-Generated Works)
6. LEGAL ISSUES & SYLLOGISM (Fact -> Rule -> Authority -> Application -> Conclusion)
7. CLAIM MAP MATRIX (Comparative color-coded 🟢🟠🔴 claim matrix across selected jurisdictions)
8. EVIDENCE MAP & AUDIT TRAIL (Direct linkage from claim assertions to uploaded artifact hash & timestamps)
9. EVIDENCE GAPS & PRESERVATION (Forensic warnings on prompt logs, intermediate seed files, raw revision records)
10. LAWYER REVIEW DOSSIER & DEFENSE BRIEF EXPORT (Print/PDF ready formal memo format)

sample_case_study.title: Sarah Chen's Sci-Fi Novella: 'The Silicon Diaspora'
sample_case_study.description: A 28,000-word speculative fiction novella created with an iterative human-AI workflow. Sarah generated character seeds and environmental descriptions using Claude 3.5 Sonnet, heavily rewrote every scene (3 drafts), introduced novel plot twists, structured the 5-act narrative arc manually, and hand-crafted all dialogue and thematic motifs.

components.name: Overarching Narrative Structure & 5-Act Plot Arc
components.fact: Sarah manually drafted an 8-page master beat sheet, created character backstories before any AI generation, and reorganized all AI scene suggestions into an original non-linear timeline.
components.rule: Selection, coordination, and arrangement of unprotected elements can sustain copyright if done by human author.
components.authority: US: Feist v. Rural (1991); USCO Guidance on Works Containing AI (2023); IN: Eastern Book Co. v. D.B. Modak (2008) 'Modicum of Creativity'; UK: Walter v. Lane / Ladbroke v. William Hill
components.application: The master plot architecture originated 100% from Sarah's intellect. AI did not devise the overarching story structure.

components.name: Raw AI Scene Drafts & Background Worldbuilding Passages
components.fact: Raw paragraphs generated in Claude 3.5 Sonnet describing the atmospheric conditions of the colony planet Kepler-452b were taken without line-by-line stylistic alteration in Chapter 2.
components.rule: US: Works created purely by non-human machines lack statutory authorship (Thaler v. Perlmutter 2023). IN: Author must be a natural person under Sec 2(d). UK: CDPA s.9(3) grants authorship to the person who made the arrangements necessary for the creation of computer-generated work, but ownership threshold remains untested for standard prompting.
components.authority: USCO Zarya of the Dawn Decision (2023); Stephen Thaler v. Shira Perlmutter (D.D.C. 2023); UK CDPA 1988 s.9(3)
components.application: Under US and Indian law, unmodified passages must be explicitly disclaimed in registration filing. Under UK law, prompt-maker argument exists but carries litigation risk.
components.conclusion: Disclaim in US/India; Flag as Uncertain in UK.

components.name: Character Dialogue & Emotional Conflicts
components.fact: AI provided rudimentary dialogue suggestions. Sarah discarded 75% of lines, rewrote cadence, added dialect markers, and injected psychological subtext over 4 manual edit passes.
components.rule: Human transformative modification and stylistic rewriting imparts requisite original human expression to derivative or mixed passages.
components.authority: US: 17 U.S.C. § 101, 103; IN: R.G. Anand v. Delux Films (1978); UK: Designers Guild v. Russell Williams
components.application: The final expressive phrasing, cadence, and subtext constitute independent human intellectual creation.
components.conclusion: Potentially Claimable as human expressive contribution.

components.name: Visual Cover Art & Concept Illustrations
components.qualitative_contribution: AI-Generated from Text Prompts with Minor Color Grading
components.fact: Cover was generated via Midjourney v6 with prompt 'cyberpunk archivist in decaying neon library'. Sarah only cropped and applied an Instagram-style contrast filter.
components.rule: Prompts alone do not constitute human authorship over generated visual pixels (USCO Kashtanova / Allen Théâtre D'opéra Spatial rulings).
components.authority: US Copyright Office Board of Review: 'Théâtre D’opéra Spatial' (Sept 2023); Kashtanova 'Zarya of the Dawn' (Feb 2023)
components.application: Prompting acts as commissioning rather than direct execution of pictorial expression. Minor cropping fails the modicum of human creativity test.
components.conclusion: Exclude visual cover image from claim in US & India; disclaim on Form TX / VA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade React SPA with an uncompromising 'Legal Evidence Workspace' aesthetic reminiscent of Linear, Palantir Gotham, and high-end editorial law platforms.
Strictly avoid generic chatbot UIs (NO speech bubbles, NO 'AI says' banter). All analysis must follow formal legal syllogism (FACT -> RULE -> AUTHORITY -> APPLICATION -> CONCLUSION).

Ensure the Contribution Map uses qualitative descriptors (e.g., 'Substantial Human Refinement', 'Independent Human Origin', 'Predominantly AI') and NEVER renders deceptive fake percentage meters (e.g., NO '72% Human / 28% AI').

Provide a fully interactive Sarah Chen sample case study ('The Silicon Diaspora') with preloaded evidence files, 5 creation timeline events, 4 decomposed components, 3-jurisdiction legal analyses, and claim matrices.
Allow users to also start a fresh workspace, switch between Written Works and Visual Artwork, toggle jurisdictions (India / US / UK), edit/add creation events, and trigger forensic re-analysis.
Implement the full Claim Map Matrix with clear 🟢 (POTENTIALLY_CLAIMABLE), 🟠 (UNCERTAIN), and 🔴 (EXCLUDE) color coding and detailed jurisdictional justification popups.

Include an Evidence Map showing file hash verification, traceability drill-downs ('Why this conclusion?'), and an Evidence Gap detector providing actionable preservation advice for copyright registration.
Implement an attorney-grade Lawyer Review Dossier & Registration Defense Memo with Print/PDF export preview, generated USCO/Indian Copyright disclaimers, and statutory citation index.
